full_judgment: This second appeal arises out of a suit for declaration. 10.80 acres of land appertaining to R.S. Khatian No. 10118 of Mouza Gomai P.S. Rangunia belonged to the Government in khas. In Settlement Case. No. 186B of 1961-62 the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Chittagong (Respondent No. 3) battled 4.20 acres of land with the plaintiffs and 6.60 acres of land with respondent Nos. 4-7. The plaintiffs moved the Commissioner of Chittagong and the Board of Revenue against the settlement in favour of respondent Nos. 4-7 unsuccessfully. Thereafter they instituted other suit No. 39 of 1969 for a declaration that the order of settlement in respect of 6.60 acres of land in suit in favour of the respondents Nos. 4-7 was void and illegal. The respondents contested the suit. The Trial Court dismissed the suit and the judgment of the trial Court was affirmed by the lower Appellate Court. Being aggrieved, the plaintiffs have preferred this second Appeal.
